decisions.reason: As a close-to-core template offer in a growing firm with hiring and R&D, it is likely kept because there is no clear sign of performance below aspiration and the firm has enough slack to continue testing it.

This responsive website template fits the established hosting and web project business well, so boundedly rational management would usually retain it absent clear underperformance relative to aspirations.
Premium customer support is highly aligned with the firm's core service logic and likely supports existing customers, making it less likely to fall below aspiration and more likely to be retained.

The software version management tool builds directly on the firm's technical capabilities and was given a dedicated page, so with organizational slack and strategic fit it is likely kept while results are still being learned.

Because it is more distant from the established offer, this product faces the greatest risk of falling short of aspiration, but the firm's current growth, broad portfolio, and visible commitment still make near-term retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
